title: Residential Construction
description: Bespoke residential building from groundbreaking to handover. We engineer architecturally stunning independent duplexes, luxury villas, and multi-family homes throughout Indore with lifetime structural durability.
longDescription: Building a custom home is one of life's most meaningful milestones. At Shivom Builders, we combine cutting-edge structural engineering with artisan craftsmanship. From deep foundation pile casting and earthquake-resistant RCC frames to thermal insulation and sound-dampening acoustic layouts, every residence is tailored to how your family lives.
features: Custom floor plan execution tailored to plot dimensions
Earthquake-resistant Fe-550D RCC frame construction
Vastu-aligned spatial orientation and natural daylighting
Waterproofing with 10-year structural warranty
Premium electrical conduits and plumbing manifolds
Milestone-based progress reporting with photo updates

title: Commercial Construction
description: High-capacity commercial complexes, corporate offices, and mixed-use retail spaces built for commercial longevity, heavy foot traffic, and maximum lease utility.
longDescription: Commercial real estate demands uncompromising speed, structural safety, and high architectural curb appeal. We build corporate office complexes, commercial arcades, and healthcare clinics that provide flexible open-span layouts, heavy electrical load management, and compliant safety ingress.
features: Large-span post-tensioned beam & column layouts
Commercial fire safety, hydrant, and egress engineering
High-durability stone and vitrified commercial flooring
Integrated HVAC ducting and electrical conduit network
Exterior curtain wall & structural glazing facade
Rapid turnaround schedules to accelerate tenant occupancy

title: Architectural Design & 3D Elevations
description: Comprehensive architectural drafting, photorealistic 3D exterior elevations, structural load calculations, and municipal sanction documentation.
longDescription: Great buildings begin with visionary architecture. Our in-house architectural team crafts contemporary front elevations, volumetric cantilevers, and climate-responsive facades. We deliver photorealistic daytime and twilight 3D renders so you experience your home before a single brick is laid.
features: Photorealistic 3D exterior visualization (day & night lighting)
Detailed 2D working floor plans & cross-sections
Structural beam, slab, and footing load drawings
Sun-path and wind analysis for natural passive cooling
Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC) building sanction assistance
Precise Bill of Quantities (BOQ) material schedules

title: Interior & Turnkey Fitouts
description: Seamless turnkey interior design, bespoke veneer woodwork, false ceilings, architectural ambient lighting, and modular kitchen installations.
longDescription: A home's interior should feel like a sanctuary. We bridge the gap between exterior architecture and intimate living spaces. Our interior craftsmen install Italian marble, warm teak woodwork, magnetic track lighting, and soft acoustic Gyproc false ceilings.
features: Saint-Gobain Gyproc false ceilings with concealed cove lighting
Custom wardrobe and kitchen cabinetry in marine-grade ply
Italian marble, granite, and large-format porcelain tiling
Concealed copper plumbing with Jaquar luxury fittings
Smart home automation & mood-lighting integration
Zero-VOC Asian Paints Royale luxury emulsion finishes
